replaces.idea: A potted bonsai tree with tiny paper tags hanging from its branches to represent the DOM tree.
A row of wooden nesting dolls on a plinth to represent the concentric layers of the CSS box model.
A waist-high transit turnstile with an indicator lamp to represent a CORS preflight gate.
A sloped metal paint tray with a green-soaked roller to represent browser repaint flashing.
A tall folding frosted-glass privacy screen on brass feet to represent a Shadow DOM boundary.
A benchtop strip-chart recorder tracing staggered ink bars on paper tape to represent the DevTools performance timeline.

new.name: DOM Bonsai
new.depicts: A small gnarled bonsai tree planted in a squat rectangular ceramic pot on four stubby feet, with three clipped leafy pads.
new.focal: Tiny cream paper node-tags dangling from the branches.

new.name: Box-Model Dolls
new.depicts: Three wooden nesting dolls lined up from largest to smallest on a thin wooden plinth, each painted with a different coloured band.
new.focal: The open middle doll revealing the smaller painted doll nested inside.

new.name: Preflight Turnstile
new.depicts: A waist-high brushed-steel transit turnstile bolted to a floor plate, with three angled metal tripod arms and a topped card reader.
new.focal: A tiny amber-and-green indicator lamp on the reader head.

new.name: Repaint Roller
new.depicts: A sloped metal paint tray standing on two rear legs, with a fuzzy green roller resting diagonally against the ribbed ramp.
new.focal: A bright green paint stripe pooling at the bottom of the tray.

new.name: Shadow-DOM Screen
new.depicts: A tall folding privacy screen with three hinged frosted-glass panels in dark-navy frames, standing on four brass feet.
new.focal: Blurred coloured silhouettes faintly visible behind the frosted centre panel.

new.name: Frame Seismograph
new.depicts: A compact benchtop strip-chart recorder on rubber feet, with a brass stylus arm poised over a scrolled paper tape.
new.focal: Staggered green and orange ink bars traced along the paper strip.

new.name: Service-Worker Pager
new.depicts: A chunky dark-slate belt pager standing upright in a small charging cradle, with a stubby antenna and a belt clip.
new.focal: A glowing green-lit two-line LCD window on its front face.

rework.redesign: Redraw as a solid, 1-px-outlined pixel-art critter—a tiny scuttle-bug with a 6x6+ body, a tiny orange tab-ear on top, and two 1x1 dark-ink eyes.
